capabilities.description: Generates and tracks interim payment certificates and progress claims by measuring completed quantities against BOQ line items from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx (P1-P5, E1-E5), applying retention under Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf.

Monitors the 730-day Time for Completion from Clause 8.2 and computes delay damages at 0.1% per day capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount per Clause 8.7, with alerting as the completion date approaches.

Captures Inspection and Test Plan records with inspection status, hold points, and evidence links, supporting the defects liability position under Clause 11.1 and the contractual quality record trail.

Maintains the project document register including the source-of-record documents document:harbourline_boq.xlsx and document:harbourline_contract.pdf, with versioning, metadata, and retrieval for contract clauses and BOQ items.
Tracks the 10% Performance Security under Clause 4.2 and the 5% retention with 50%/50% release schedule under Clause 14.3, as a contractual obligation ledger.
Provides a working view of the Accepted Contract Amount derived from BOQ line items and the contract, with rollups used by delay damages and claim calculations.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that tracks progress claims against the BOQ, monitors delay damages under the contract, and manages QA/ITP records and a document register. The uploaded contract and BOQ are the source of record, anchored to the project works described in document:harbourline_boq.xlsx and the contractual provisions in document:harbourline_contract.pdf.
